notes.pixelMask: The alpha channel of each PNG is the exact pixel mask; pixels outside it are transparent.
notes.polygon: Editor outline in SOURCE image pixels (origin top-left, +y down). Not used for cutting unless cutBy=polygon.
notes.unityPhysicsShape: Separately simplified outline in EXPORTED frame pixels relative to the pivot (+y up). Divide by pixelsPerUnit for Sprite.OverridePhysicsShape.
